        To find the minimum sum of a k-avoiding array of length n, we want to pick the smallest distinct positive integers possible.
        
        A k-avoiding array means no two distinct elements sum to k.

        1. Start with the smallest positive integer (1) and try to add it if it doesn't form a pair summing to k with any already chosen number.
        2. Since we want the minimum sum, we greedily pick the smallest available integers.
